note: Arthur as the only crossing companion (Exec Summary step 4-8, Technical Strategy invariants): after the briefing he walks from the hall to the launch's berth and boards (the boat will not cast off until he is aboard); BOARDING_THRESHOLD fires when the player comes up to the launch with Arthur aboard; SHIP_SIGHTED a few seconds after casting off; on the return, when the launch docks at the lighthouse (RETURN_ARRIVED) Arthur says 'go go go, don't wait for me', steps ashore and leaves the player to climb. scripts/world/boarding_sequence.gd reads this file.
seat_note: Boat (rig) space: beside and just ahead of the helm (the player stands at 0, 0.5, 0.2); the engine block and funnel are aft with the cargo slot (0, 0.13, 1.3).
stays_aboard_note: Creator, 30 Oct 2026: Arthur stays in his seat on the launch after the return crossing. Set false to bring back the old step ashore onto jetty_spot after ashore_delay_s.
